items.label: Modern Natural Design for Any Home
items.value: Blending clean lines with authentic woodgrain textures, this TV stand captures a modern yet organic look that suits a variety of interior styles—from minimalist and contemporary to rustic farmhouse. Available in multiple natural finishes, it brings warmth, balance, and understated elegance to your living space.

items.label: Generous Storage with Hidden Cabinets
items.value: Designed to keep your living room clutter-free, this console features a spacious open shelf (36"W × 16"D × 18"H) divided into two tiers—ideal for media players, décor, or books. Two side cabinets offer additional hidden storage for remotes, game consoles, or accessories, combining convenience with a clean, streamlined look.

items.label: Wide, Durable Top for Large TVs
items.value: The 70"W × 16"D tabletop accommodates flat-screen TVs up to 80" with ease. Built for both form and function, the top surface supports up to 300 lbs—perfect for your TV, speakers, décor, or soundbar.

items.label: Solid Base & Smart Cable Management
items.value: A sturdy 3.5" one-piece plinth base adds stability while enhancing the overall design. Four built-in cable holes are strategically placed behind both the center shelves and side cabinets to keep wires neatly out of sight—no messy tangles.

items.label: Easy Assembly & Worry-Free Support
items.value: Ships in one secure package with clear instructions and labeled parts for a smooth setup experience. Recommended for two adults, assembly takes 60 minutes or less. Backed by OKD’s professional customer service team, with responsive support for any questions before or after purchase.
